name: Allow people to hold Stories out of automatic dispatch
description:
Factory review recommendation 13 of 20.

## Context

Every Story entering an enabled Stage is currently eligible for dispatch, including work a person wants to handle manually.

## Acceptance criteria

- Define an explicit hold mechanism for individual Stories.
- Exclude held Stories from automatic dispatch and show why they are held.
- Allow releasing the hold to restore normal eligibility without losing Story or Stage Run context.

Recheck the reviewed behavior against the current implementation and configuration before making changes. Update the relevant documentation, skill guidance and repository configuration together where applicable.

comments.body: Supervisor decision: Revised plan accepted with separate per-Story hold.json and no Stage Run bag format change/migration. Canonical row field is eligibility and startRun rechecks it under the operation lock; ROW-58 owns eligibility.ts. Its implementation branch factory/row-58 is now pushed/being finalized: inspect it for interface reference, but base your task on main (no stack/merge companion branch without approval). Include doctor reporting for unreadable/unsupported hold via existing Plugin doctor mechanism, because compatibility policy requires unknown data be reported, and document any finding in guide/operating refs. New v1 file has no migration so do not invent migration machinery. Required tests remain in existing homes and suite<=100. Read rowbly-tui-design for Story row. ADR0043 reserved; recheck. All four checks/manual scenarios and screenshots required. Proceed.

comments.body: Correction pushed to draft PR https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/141 (head 296a69d). hold.json is now strict: a v1 file with unknown fields counts as unreadable, so the Story stays held, doctor reports SOFTWARE_FACTORY_UNREADABLE_HOLD naming the fields, and hold and release exit 6 (DATA_INTEGRITY) leaving the bytes unchanged. hold and release now read the file through the same helper as eligibility and doctor, so a symbolic link or unreadable path gives DATA_INTEGRITY exit 6 instead of VALIDATION; the link is never followed and neither it nor its outside target changes. The existing hold test step now covers future-version, unknown-field and symlink files for both commands. typecheck, lint, test:unit 78 and test:cli 20 pass; screenshots are in a PR comment.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor plan review: Plan needs two revisions before implementation. Adopt ROW-58's canonical eligibility:{eligible:boolean,reasons:[{code,message,blockers?}]} shape; use code HELD and derive Waiting table text from reasons, no parallel waiting[] contract. ROW-58 owns eligibility.ts and blocked-link integration; you own hold persistence, hold/release commands and hold rendering. Required reason and surviving Stage changes are within Story scope. BUT optional hold beside a still-valid legacy stageRun is not compatible with docs/plugins/compatibility.md §3.4: old readers would silently erase a hold and unexpectedly resume dispatch. Do not document harmful hold loss as acceptable or merely add version:2 that old Zod drops. Propose safe storage: consider a separate Plugin-owned per-Story hold file that older versions never rewrite, or a versioned shape old schema rejects with explicit migration/test policy. Prefer the smallest solution that preserves holds and existing Stage Runs. Keep ADR-0043 provisionally for hold; recheck before publishing. Do not add new glossary Avoid words such as pause/lock/freeze globally unless necessary; lock is an existing core storage term. Return adjusted storage/interface plan before editing; TUI work must use rowbly-tui-design. ROWBLY.md remains proposed diff only.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/141. Adds rowbly software-factory hold <KEY> --reason <text> and release <KEY>. A hold is a Story-scope file, hold.json (version 1, ADR-0043), so the Stage Run data on the Story keeps its shape, nothing is migrated, and older Rowbly releases never drop it. A held Story gets a HELD reason in ROW-58's eligibility, so run start refuses it (exit 4, --retry included), and the reason shows in runs, in stories show and on the TUI Story screen. The hold stays through Stage changes and never touches the Stage Run, so release restores eligibility with the attempt unchanged. A hold file that can't be read counts as held, is left unchanged by hold and release (exit 6), and is reported by doctor as SOFTWARE_FACTORY_UNREADABLE_HOLD. typecheck, lint, test:unit (78) and test:cli (20) pass; screenshots are in a PR comment.
